products.title: HIGH5/LeCol Short Sleeve Cycle Jersey Womens
products.body_html:
The first ever official HIGH5 cycling jersey has arrived.

Created in partnership with premium cycling apparel specialists Le Col, this limited-edition jersey combines HIGH5's passion for endurance performance with Le Col's proven expertise in technical cycling clothing.

Whether you're training for your next sportive, racing through summer miles or simply representing the brand that fuels your rides, this jersey is designed to keep you comfortable from the first pedal stroke to the finish.

Built using lightweight, breathable fabrics and a close performance fit, it delivers comfort, moisture management and freedom of movement for rides of every distance.
This is a strictly limited production run. Once it's gone, it won't be repeated.

The official HIGH5 x Le Col Bib Shorts are built for long training rides, sportives and race days, combining Le Col's renowned comfort with the unmistakable HIGH5 identity.

Designed around Le Col's trusted Club Bib Shorts platform, they feature supportive compressive fabrics, an ergonomic multi-density chamois and breathable mesh bib straps to deliver comfort hour after hour.

Whether you're chasing a new PB or enjoying weekend miles with friends, these bib shorts are built to perform.

Produced in limited numbers, this exclusive collaboration won't be repeated.

products.title: Run Bottle (Bio-Based)
products.body_html:
A quality 350ml Bio-based water bottle that is easy to use during any exercise with a rubber mouth piece for comfort and an easy hand grip for running.

Why we love it: 

  • Made from sugarcane-based polyethylene, a renewable resource.
  • Captures CO₂ during the sugarcane growth process, helping reduce overall greenhouse gas emissions.
  • Lower environmental footprint compared to fossil-fuel-based plastics, including reduced emissions during production.
  • Fully recyclable. Use, recycle, repeat!

products.title: 750ml Dual Fuel Sports Bottle
products.body_html:
The HIGH5 Dual Fuel water bottle is a 2 in 1! A water bottle with a gel pouch built in so you can effortlessly alternate between the two.

This high-quality bottle has two components: A 750ml container for your fluid and a detachable, refillable gel pouch for your Energy Gel.

The gel pouch, which holds up to 3 servings, conveniently screws into the lid. The lid features a unique switch function that allows you to effortlessly alternate between sipping your ZERO Electrolyte drink and consuming your Energy Gel during exercise. 

    • No more sticky hands
    • No more single use plastic (if you choose to pair it with our Refillable gel)
    • Only carry one item with you on the go
